audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are peers penalized for sending over-cap transactions?
audit_items.skip_reason: component-mismatch: EL transaction validation concern (peer penalization for over-cap gasLimit transactions) audited against Prysm, a CL (consensus layer) client. Prysm does not manage EL transaction pools or enforce EL gas limits. P2P peer scoring in Prysm applies to CL gossip topics (blocks, attestations, slashings), not EL transactions. Transaction validation and mempool management are handled by EL clients (e.g., go-ethereum).

audit_items.skip_reason: component-mismatch: This check concerns EL transaction validation bypass via trusted peers. Prysm's P2P layer validates CL gossip messages (blocks, attestations, slashings) independently via pubsub validators (e.g., validateAttesterSlashing, validateAggregateAndProof), but does not handle EL transaction validation. The property references 'over-cap transactions' with entry point 'P2P' and trust boundaries tb-002/tb-009, which map to EL transaction pool concerns not present in the CL client.
